draft_key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance: Revenue increased 40% to DKK 126.5m (2024: DKK 90.1m), EBITDA grew 26% to DKK 31.1m (2024: DKK 24.7m), and Profit Before Tax (EBT) surged 109% to DKK 19.0m (2024: DKK 9.1m), driven by scaling of core titles and ad revenue optimization.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Highlights & Key Ratios table (page 24); Financial Performance section (pages 24-27)

draft_key_information_units.information: The 'Big 3' titles—Airline Manager, Truck Manager, and Farm Manager—collectively generated 67% of 2025 revenue (DKK 85m) and 65% of EBITDA, with Truck Manager up 1,971% to DKK 25.2m and Farm Manager contributing DKK 22.0m in its first six months post-launch.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Progress & Results section (pages 13-20); Game Breakdown table (page 13)

draft_key_information_units.information: Strategic ad revenue optimization initiated in late September 2025 boosted In-App Ads (IAA) revenue by 100% to DKK 18.5m, improving monetization efficiency by eliminating platform fees and increasing IAA's share of total revenue to 14.6% (2024: 10.2%).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Strategic Ad Revenue Optimisation section (pages 21-22); Financial Performance section (page 26)

draft_key_information_units.information: Operational milestones included Truck Manager's foundational scaling (revenue growth from DKK 1.2m in 2024 to DKK 25.2m in 2025) and Farm Manager's successful July 2025 launch with 5 million pre-registrations, establishing both as primary growth engines.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Truck Manager section (page 17); Farm Manager section (page 18); Progress & Results (page 14)

draft_key_information_units.information: 2026 financial guidance targets revenue of DKK 130-153m (+3% to +21%) and EBITDA of DKK 28-36m, with strategic focus on optimizing the existing portfolio, disciplined investment in Train Manager 2 and Space Manager, and maintaining margin discipline amid regulatory uncertainty.

Strong liquidity position with a 78% solvency ratio (2024: 86%), total equity of DKK 66.1m, and completion of a DKK 5m share buy-back program, reflecting a robust capital structure with no interest-bearing debt.

Framework-driven development strategy enables cost-efficient title launches, portfolio-wide upgrades, and a competitive moat, as evidenced by reusable codebases and retrofitting features like staff management and stock markets across titles.

evaluation.selection_rationale: Units were selected based on materiality to concise financial-report summaries per prioritization criteria: D1 captures headline performance; D2-D4 detail major drivers and operational execution; D5 reflects forward-looking guidance; D6 covers liquidity/capital position; D7 addresses core strategic differentiation. All units represent independently omittable themes directly supported by SOURCE evidence, with REFERENCE SUMMARY validating salience. Excluded routine boilerplate (governance, risk lists, accounting policies) per instructions.
